title: 三脚付き測量器
description: 建設現場や道路測量のシーン向けの据置測量器。伸縮脚のレールと固定レバー、整準ねじ、左右の支持塔、望遠鏡外装、対物・接眼面、操作面と開いた持ち手を造形。光学面と表示面は不透明材質で、測距・測角・水平調整や可動機構は実装していません。測量精度や現場機器としての適合は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.924 × 1.713 × 0.801 m、11,372三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A stationary survey-instrument prop for construction and street-survey scenes, with sliding tripod rails and clamps, leveling screws, twin trunnion towers, telescope housing, objective/eyepiece faces, controls and open carrying handle. Optical and display faces are opaque materials; distance/angle measurement, leveling and articulation are not implemented. Survey accuracy and real equipment compliance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.924 × 1.713 × 0.801 m; 11,372 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
